verdict.rationale: Metorial documents its own catalog of pre-built integrations, claimed at 1200+ integrations including custom MCP servers. Portals let users discover approved integrations, and a key-gated providers API endpoint is live. However, no evidence shows a developer-facing search or filter of the catalog by capability or tool before wiring it into an agent. missing for 10: documented search or filter by capability, tool-level browsing of catalog entries before connecting, independent hands-on corroboration of catalog discovery UX.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search and browse a large catalog of MCP servers and tools by capability before wiring anything into my agent

citations.quote: Beyond the pre-built integrations in the Metorial catalog, you can upload your own MCP server code and let Metorial host it.
1200+ integrations across SaaS tools, enterprise systems, data sources, and custom MCP servers.
Portals are branded places where users discover and connect approved integrations, skills, and MCP access.
